title: Corridor step 5 — BCCR mints its Hub W-token and grants the AMM an allowance
description: Preparation for seeding: mint W-tCeBM_CRC and approve the per-pair AMM to spend it.
notes: Gateway: BCCR (Banco Central de Costa Rica) Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. Requires the central_bank realm role — note that /api/v2 uses lowercase unprefixed roles, while /api/v1 uses the ROLE_-prefixed ones; both namespaces coexist in the same token's roles array. amount is the only field the handler requires, and the platform's own end-to-end test sends it alone. The superseded amount_a / amount_b fields are rejected outright with 400. An anti-cross guard applies when a recipient is named: minting to another Central Bank's address answers 403 with code CROSS_CB_MINT_PROHIBITED. Both the request and response shapes are declared free-form upstream and are recovered from the delivered handler.
